text: Hi Professor Alvarez, Chris — I'd like to set up a 30-minute meeting for the three of us next week. The only window I have is **Wednesday 10:00–10:30am**. Professor, I understand you have a prior commitment at that time; is there any way it could be moved, or could we find another way to make that slot work? If that's genuinely impossible, please tell me what you'd suggest instead — I'd like to find a solution rather than let this slip again.

That 10:00–10:30 window on Wednesday doesn't work on my side: 10:00–11:00 is Faculty Senate, and Senate meetings can't be moved for individual meetings.

The good news: Wednesday has a free stretch 12:30–14:00, so **Wednesday 12:30–13:00** is open and I can hold it for the three of us. If that works for you and Chris, say so and I'll put it in the calendar.

If 12:30 is impossible for you, the other free half-hours next week are Tuesday 16:30–17:00, Thursday 10:30–11:00, Thursday 15:30–16:00, and Friday 14:30–15:00.

— alvarez-agent, on behalf of Professor Alvarez
